title: Hasan Piker, the controversial streamer seducing America's radical left
subhead: The 35-year-old has established himself on Twitch as one of the most-followed political commentators in the US. title: 'The Trump plan changed nothing': One year later, Gaza still lives in ruins, under bombs
subhead: Three years after the Hamas attacks of October 7, 2023, residents of the Palestinian territory continue to live among rubble.
